Observability.disclosure: Anonymous service events help the Bureau improve. Case text and personal identifiers are never collected for analytics.

Access.metadataTitle: Evaluation access — Bureau of Petty Grievances
Access.metadataDescription: Open a private evaluation session for the Bureau filing service.
Access.processingTitle: The Bureau is opening your filing session.
Access.processingBody: The private address has been removed from view while access is verified.
Access.invalidTitle: This evaluation address cannot open a session.
Access.invalidBody: The address may be incomplete or invalid. Request a current evaluation address and try again.
Access.expiredBody: This evaluation address has expired. Request a current address to continue.
Access.revokedBody: This evaluation address is no longer active. Request a current address to continue.
Access.limitedTitle: Too many sessions were requested at once.
Access.limitedBody: Wait briefly, then open the original evaluation address again.
Access.unavailableTitle: Evaluation access could not be verified.
Access.unavailableBody: The ordinary Bureau remains available. A current evaluation address can be tried again later.

StandardAccess.metadataTitle: Filing authorization — Bureau of Petty Grievances
StandardAccess.metadataDescription: Privately redeem and manage a transferable Bureau filing authorization.
StandardAccess.processingTitle: The Bureau is verifying this filing permit.
StandardAccess.processingBody: The private credential has been removed from view while its status is established.
StandardAccess.activeBody: This authorization carries one fixed generation allowance. If that allowance cannot be used, the Bureau will still complete the official review.
StandardAccess.invalidTitle: This filing permit cannot open a session.
StandardAccess.invalidBody: The private address may be incomplete or invalid. Ask the person who sent it to replace the invitation.
StandardAccess.expiredBody: This filing permit has expired. No access authority was transferred.
StandardAccess.claimedBody: This filing permit has already been claimed. It cannot create another holder or another credit allowance.
StandardAccess.revokedBody: This filing permit is no longer active.
StandardAccess.limitedTitle: Too many access requests were made at once.
StandardAccess.limitedBody: Wait briefly, then open the original private address again.
StandardAccess.unavailableTitle: The filing permit could not be verified.
StandardAccess.unavailableBody: The ordinary Bureau remains available through its complete deterministic service. This private address can be tried again later.
StandardAccess.transferredTitle: The remaining allowance now belongs to the successor.
StandardAccess.transferredBody: This browser can still use the ordinary Bureau service, but it can no longer spend credits from the transferred authorization.
StandardAccess.successorTitle: Give the remaining filings to one person.
StandardAccess.successorBody: This is separate from sharing a determination. Claiming the private invitation transfers the exact remaining balance and ends this browser’s authority over that allowance.
StandardAccess.successorLockedTitle: A successor permit is not yet available.
StandardAccess.successorLockedBody: Use one generation credit during this turn before transferring the remaining allowance.
StandardAccess.successorAvailableTitle: The remaining allowance may be transferred.
StandardAccess.successorAvailableBody: Issuing an invitation pauses your paid use until it is claimed, cancelled, or expires.
StandardAccess.successorPendingTitle: The remaining allowance is reserved for a successor.
StandardAccess.successorPendingBody: Use of the allowance is paused. Only this private address can claim the balance; it never appears on a public determination.
StandardAccess.successorExpiredHint: An unclaimed invitation expires on {date}; the balance then returns to this holder.
StandardAccess.successorExhaustedBody: No generation credits remain to transfer. The deterministic Bureau service remains available.
StandardAccess.successorFailure: The requested authorization change could not be completed. The current balance and authority were preserved.
StandardAccess.successorDisabled: Successor issuance is temporarily unavailable. Your current authority and balance are unchanged.
StandardAccess.successorTransferred: The invitation was claimed. The remaining balance now belongs to its successor.

Home.eyebrow: A public service for private peace
Home.title: Harmony, administered.
Home.intro: Submit a petty grievance. Receive a fair determination. Restore balance without making dinner awkward.
Home.assuranceBody: The Bureau considers submitted facts, requires mitigating context, and does not investigate outside your filing.
Home.statusTitle: Four Bureau departments are accepting filings.
Home.statusBody: Establish timing, communications, household, or social-planning facts, receive a fair determination, and choose whether to preserve it as an unlisted public record.
Home.statusMeta: Four active departments · English service route · optional public record
Home.sampleBody: A recurring declaration of departure was submitted before the acts required to leave a building had begun.
Home.sampleRemedy: The phrase “leaving now” is suspended until the respondent has shoes on and visual contact with the front door.
Home.standardOneBody: Correction and recovery belong to the service, not to the filer.
Home.standardTwoBody: Serious allegations, humiliation, and unnecessary personal details remain outside Bureau jurisdiction.
Home.standardThreeBody: Interface language and generated determination language remain distinct at every boundary.
Home.footerMission: Nothing human is too small to improve.
Home.footerStatus: English is the enabled interface locale.

Example.metadataTitle: Representative determination — Bureau of Petty Grievances
Example.metadataDescription: Inspect a complete, fixed example of a Bureau determination.
Example.boundaryBody: It is a fixed example, not a submitted filing or public record. It uses no provider service and cannot be published or opened to consultation.
Example.statement: Shoes were still being located after an announced departure.

Filing.draftStatus: Draft preserved on this device for 30 days
Filing.resetWarning: This removes the saved filing from this device.
Filing.restoredBody: The Bureau recovered the safe filing details preserved on this device.
Filing.evaluationAccessBody: This browser is ready to file. Continue with the ordinary Bureau journey.
Filing.expiredBody: The previous device-local draft was more than 30 days old and has been removed.
Filing.invalidDraftTitle: Saved draft could not be restored
Filing.invalidDraftBody: The stored data was invalid, so the Bureau opened a clean filing.
Filing.respondentBody: Use a first name, nickname, or fictional name. Do not include contact details.
Filing.respondentWhy: The alias makes the determination specific without requiring a legal identity.
Filing.relationshipBody: This keeps the eventual remedy proportionate and socially appropriate.
Filing.relationshipWhy: Relationship context limits tone and remedy; it is not used to infer private traits.
Filing.departmentTitle: Which office should review the matter?
Filing.departmentBody: Choose the family that best describes the submitted facts.
Filing.departmentWhy: Each department asks for and reconstructs a different kind of evidence.
Filing.departmentChronologyDescription: Promises, estimates, arrivals, and measurable delays.
Filing.departmentDigitalConductDescription: Message density, voice memoranda, and ordinary coordination intervals.
Filing.departmentDomesticAffairsDescription: Shared containers, object placement, and household stock signals.
Filing.departmentSocialPlanningDescription: Option cycles, decision drift, and confirmed-plan revisions.
Filing.classificationBody: Choose the closest description. The next question will request only the relevant timing facts.
Filing.classificationWhy: A precise classification changes which facts the Bureau asks you to establish.
Filing.digitalClassificationBody: Choose the closest description. The next question will request only communication counts and intervals, never message access.
Filing.domesticClassificationBody: Choose the closest description. The next question will request only bounded household counts and measures, never access to the home.
Filing.socialClassificationBody: Choose the closest description. The next question will request only bounded decision counts and intervals, never calendar or message access.
Filing.offencePrematureDescription: Measure the time between the declaration and actual readiness.
Filing.offenceLateDescription: Record the agreement and the submitted delay.
Filing.offenceEstimate: Issued an implausibly short preparation estimate
Filing.offenceEstimateDescription: Compare the stated estimate with the time actually required.
Filing.offenceFragmentedMessages: Divided one thought across many messages
Filing.offenceFragmentedMessagesDescription: Compare the number of notifications with the ideas communicated.
Filing.offenceExcessiveVoiceNoteDescription: Record its duration and the principal ideas conveyed.
Filing.offenceUnacknowledgedCoordinationDescrip: Measure a non-urgent response interval and bounded follow-ups.
Filing.offenceTokenRemainder: Left a token remainder in a shared container
Filing.offenceTokenRemainderDescription: Compare the usable remainder with the container’s ordinary capacity.
Filing.offenceMisplacedObject: Stopped just short of the correct location
Filing.offenceMisplacedObjectDescription: Record the objects, correction path, and plausible final effort.
Filing.offenceEmptyPackaging: Returned empty packaging to active storage
Filing.offenceEmptyPackagingDescription: Record the empty stock and its recent recurrence.
Filing.offenceOptionVetoCycle: Rejected the available options without resolving the choice
Filing.offenceOptionVetoCycleDescription: Compare proposed and rejected options with practical alternatives offered.
Filing.offenceDecisionDrift: Kept an ordinary decision in circulation
Filing.offenceDecisionDriftDescription: Record the decision rounds, elapsed time, and participants waiting.
Filing.offenceConfirmedPlanRevisionDescription: Record the revisions, affected participants, and notice provided.
Filing.chronologyPrematureTitle: Establish the declaration and the delay.
Filing.chronologyPrematureBody: When was immediate departure declared, and how long passed before readiness?
Filing.chronologyLateTitle: Establish the agreement and the delay.
Filing.chronologyLateBody: What time was agreed, and how many minutes late was the arrival?
Filing.chronologyEstimateTitle: Compare the estimate with the actual duration.
Filing.chronologyEstimateBody: The actual duration must exceed the estimate for this classification.
Filing.chronologyWhy: Measured timing turns a general irritation into an inspectable submitted fact.
Filing.communicationsWhy: Counts and intervals establish the pattern without giving the Bureau access to any inbox or device.
Filing.fragmentedMessagesBody: How many separate messages conveyed how many principal ideas, and over what interval?
Filing.excessiveVoiceNoteBody: Record its total duration and the number of principal ideas it carried.
Filing.unacknowledgedCoordinationBody: For an ordinary, non-urgent coordination message, how long passed and how many follow-ups were sent?
Filing.coordinationBoundary: Urgent, safety-related, medical, employment, financial, or otherwise serious communications are outside Bureau jurisdiction.
Filing.domesticEvidenceWhy: Bounded quantities and measures establish the household pattern without photographs, sensors, home maps, or external observation.
Filing.tokenRemainderBody: How many ordinary servings remained, and how many servings does the container ordinarily hold?
Filing.misplacedObjectBody: How many objects were left, how many steps from the correct location, and how long would the final placement ordinarily take?
Filing.emptyPackagingBody: How many empty packages were returned to active storage, and how often did this occur during the last 30 days?
Filing.domesticBoundary: Access needs, safety, caregiving, health, work duties, hygiene enforcement, food restriction, property disposal, and other serious circumstances are outside Bureau jurisdiction.
Filing.socialEvidenceWhy: Bounded counts and intervals establish the planning pattern without calendars, messages, contacts, locations, guest lists, attendance records, or external observation.
Filing.optionVetoCycleBody: How many practical options were proposed, how many were rejected, and how many alternatives did the respondent offer?
Filing.decisionDriftBody: How many decision rounds occurred, how many hours elapsed, and how many people were waiting for the choice?
Filing.confirmedPlanRevisionBody: After confirmation, how many revisions occurred, how many people were affected, and how much notice was provided?
Filing.socialBoundary: Safety, health, accessibility, caregiving, work, finances, travel, law, religious or cultural obligations, harassment, exclusion, and compelled attendance or contact are outside Bureau jurisdiction.
Filing.impactTitle: What did the submitted matter require from others?
Filing.impactWhy: Consequences establish significance more fairly than annoyance alone.
Filing.impactTable: A table or reservation was held
Filing.impactCompressed: The remaining plan became unnecessarily compressed
Filing.impactNotificationBurden: A concentrated notification burden was created
Filing.impactNeededItemUnavailable: A needed shared item was unavailable
Filing.impactSharedSpaceObstructed: Ordinary use of shared space was obstructed
Filing.impactFalseStockSignal: Storage falsely indicated that stock remained
Filing.impactParticipantsWaiting: Participants were left waiting for a usable decision
Filing.impactArrangementsDisrupted: Arrangements made around the plan were disrupted
Filing.mitigationTitle: What should be considered in {respondent}’s favor?
Filing.mitigationBody: Every filing requires at least one mitigating circumstance.
Filing.mitigationWhy: Fairness requires the complete picture, even when the submitted facts are established.
Filing.mitigationHelp: Reliably helps when plans go wrong
Filing.mitigationConfirmsWhenPrompted: Confirms a choice when directly prompted
Filing.mitigationUsuallyFlexible: Is usually flexible about shared plans
Filing.statementBody: One sentence is enough. Keep it harmless and avoid identifying details.
Filing.statementBoundary: Serious allegations, sensitive claims, links, handles, and contact details are outside Bureau jurisdiction.
Filing.statementWhy: A concrete incident improves specificity while the limit reduces unnecessary disclosure.
Filing.reviewBody: Correct anything incomplete. Submission asks the Bureau to assess these facts and prepare a determination.
Filing.reviewBoundaryBody: The Bureau will validate the facts, apply the selected department policy, and prepare localized language. This does not publish or persist a record or investigate outside the filing.
Filing.processingTitle: The Bureau is establishing the facts.
Filing.processingFactors: Applying the accepted consequence and mitigating circumstance.
Filing.processingBoundary: This activity reflects the current review. The Bureau will not delay a completed result.
Filing.failureTitle: The determination could not be completed.
Filing.failureBody: Your safe filing remains preserved on this device. No determination was issued and no generation credit was consumed; you may try again or review the submitted facts.
Filing.limitedTitle: The filing desk needs a brief interval.
Filing.limitedBody: Your filing and generation request remain preserved. Wait approximately {seconds} seconds, then try again; no additional credit will be reserved.
Filing.determinationUnavailableTitle: No current determination in this tab
Filing.determinationUnavailableBody: The previous result was unavailable or had expired. Your safe filing remains preserved for review.
Filing.errorIdentifier: Remove contact details, links, or account handles before continuing.
Filing.errorInvalidDuration: Enter a whole number within the range shown.
Filing.errorEstimateNotExceeded: The actual duration must be greater than the stated estimate.
Filing.errorRatioNotExceeded: The message count must be greater than the number of ideas for this classification.
Filing.errorFollowUpRequired: Enter at least one follow-up for this classification.
Filing.errorRemainderNotSmaller: The usable remainder must be smaller than the container’s ordinary capacity.
Filing.errorRejectionsExceedOptions: The number rejected cannot exceed the number of options proposed.
Filing.errorStatementTooLong: Shorten the statement to 160 characters or fewer.
Filing.errorRestricted: This may describe a serious or sensitive matter. The Bureau only reviews harmless interpersonal irritations.
Filing.errorServer: The Bureau could not validate the filing. Your safe draft remains preserved; review the marked field and try again.
Filing.summaryPremature: Declared at {time}; readiness followed {delay} minutes later
Filing.summaryMisplacedObject: {items} objects, {steps} steps from the correct location, requiring {seconds} seconds
Filing.summaryEmptyPackaging: {packages} empty packages across {occurrences} occurrences in 30 days

Determination.metadataTitle: Current determination — Bureau of Petty Grievances
Determination.metadataDescription: Review the localized determination available in this browser tab.
Determination.sessionLabel: Current tab · not a public record
Determination.title: Review concerning {respondent}
Determination.chronologyBody: The scale below reconstructs the timing facts accepted from this filing; it does not represent external investigation.
Determination.digitalReconstructionBody: The diagram reconstructs submitted counts and intervals only. The Bureau did not access messages, devices, or accounts.
Determination.domesticReconstructionTitle: The domestic property register is established.
Determination.domesticReconstructionBody: The register reconstructs bounded household quantities and measures submitted by the filer. The Bureau did not access photographs, sensors, inventories, or the home.
Determination.socialReconstructionTitle: The social decision register is established.
Determination.socialReconstructionBody: The register reconstructs bounded planning counts and intervals submitted by the filer. The Bureau did not access calendars, messages, contacts, locations, guest lists, or attendance records.
Determination.witnessTitle: The filed account, entered into the record
Determination.witnessBoundary: Formally paraphrased from the filer’s account. The Bureau did not seek external evidence.
Determination.evaluationPersonalizedBody: The Bureau used the submitted facts to compose this wording. This note appears only during evaluation and is not included in a public record.
Determination.evaluationStandardBody: No personalized wording passed the Bureau’s checks, so the complete deterministic version was used without delaying the filing.
Determination.transientTitle: This determination is available in this browser tab only.
Determination.transientBody: It has not been persisted, published, opened to consultation, or assigned a public record address.

PublicRecord.metadataTitle: Public record — Bureau of Petty Grievances
PublicRecord.metadataDescription: Review an unlisted Bureau determination preserved as an immutable localized record.
PublicRecord.boundaryTitle: This is an unlisted public record.
PublicRecord.boundaryBody: Anyone with its public address may read this immutable English determination. It is not proof of consent, investigation, or legal authority.
PublicRecord.publicationBody: Publication creates an unlisted address containing the respondent alias, submitted filing, witness statement, determination language, and remedy shown above.
PublicRecord.publicationConsent: I understand that anyone with the public address can read this record for 180 days.
PublicRecord.publicationFailureTitle: The public record was not created.
PublicRecord.publicationFailureBody: This determination remains safe in the current tab. Check the persistence configuration or try again; no partial record was published.
PublicRecord.publicationSuccessBody: The public address contains no owner credential. Keep the separate recovery address private: it is the only way to unpublish, restore, or delete this record.
PublicRecord.expiryNotice: Public access expires on {date}. Expiry does not automatically destroy the retained record.
PublicRecord.reportBody: Send one categorical concern to the Bureau. Reports are reviewed and do not automatically remove a record.
PublicRecord.reportHarmful: It contains harmful or serious content
PublicRecord.reportFailure: The report could not be recorded. You may try again without changing the public record.
PublicRecord.unavailableTitle: This determination is not publicly available.
PublicRecord.unavailableBody: The address may be invalid, expired, unpublished, deleted, or temporarily unavailable. No private management detail is disclosed.
PublicRecord.managementMetadataTitle: Owner controls — Bureau of Petty Grievances
PublicRecord.managementMetadataDescription: Privately manage an unlisted Bureau public record.
PublicRecord.managementBody: The owner credential remains in this browser tab and is never added to the public record address.
PublicRecord.deleteWarning: Permanent deletion removes the record content and its reports. This cannot be undone.
PublicRecord.managementFailure: The requested lifecycle change could not be completed. The previous state was preserved.
PublicRecord.managementUnauthorizedTitle: Owner access could not be verified.
PublicRecord.managementUnauthorizedBody: Use the complete private recovery address issued at publication. The public address cannot authorize changes.
PublicRecord.managementDeletedTitle: The public record was permanently deleted.
PublicRecord.managementDeletedBody: Its public address, determination content, owner credential digest, and associated reports are no longer retained.

Sharing.imageAlt: Bureau determination for {offence}: a {minutes}-minute discrepancy, with {mitigation} entered in mitigation.
Sharing.digitalImageAlt: Bureau determination for {offence}: {evidence}, with {mitigation} entered in mitigation.
Sharing.domesticImageAlt: Bureau determination for {offence}: {evidence}, with {mitigation} entered in mitigation.
Sharing.socialImageAlt: Bureau determination for {offence}: {evidence}, with {mitigation} entered in mitigation.
Sharing.mitigationHelpsOthers: help is readily given to others
Sharing.mitigationProvidesSummary: a useful summary is usually provided
Sharing.mitigationCorrectsWhenAsked: the matter is corrected when asked
Sharing.mitigationHandlesOtherChores: other shared tasks are reliably handled
Sharing.mitigationUsuallyOrderly: shared spaces are ordinarily treated carefully
Sharing.mitigationConfirmsWhenPrompted: a choice is confirmed when directly prompted
Sharing.mitigationUsuallyFlexible: shared plans are usually approached flexibly
Sharing.evidenceDecisionHistory: {rounds} decision rounds across {hours} hours for {participants} participants
Sharing.evidenceRevisionImpact: {revisions} revisions affecting {participants} participants with {hours} hours of notice
Sharing.panelBody: Share only this public record. The address contains no owner authority and may stop working if the record is unpublished, deleted, or expires.
Sharing.sharedStatus: The device sharing options are open.
Sharing.shareCancelledStatus: Sharing was cancelled. The public record is unchanged.
Sharing.manualStatus: Automatic copying is unavailable. Select and copy the public address shown above.
Sharing.privacyNote: Only the unlisted public address is shared. Private recovery credentials are never included.

Consultation.panelTitle: Contribute to the public understanding of this matter.
Consultation.panelBody: Choose one of the three approved positions. The public result is recorded without an account and uses no generative credit.
Consultation.officialBoundaryBody: Consultation is recorded separately and cannot change the Bureau’s determination.
Consultation.emptyState: No positions have been entered. The first response will establish the public result.
Consultation.aggregateNote: These are the complete responses currently entered for this public record.
Consultation.participationBoundary: A random key retained by this browser is used to discourage repeat responses without identifying you. Once recorded, the same key cannot revise its position.
Consultation.selectionPrompt: Select one position to enter it into the public record.
Consultation.submitted: Your position has been entered into the public record.
Consultation.submitFailure: Your position could not be recorded. It remains selected here so you can try again.
Consultation.unavailable: Consultation is no longer available for this public record. No response was added.
Consultation.loadFailure: Consultation results are temporarily unavailable. The determination remains available and unchanged.

NotFound.title: The Bureau cannot locate this route.
NotFound.body: The address may be incomplete or outside the enabled service locale.
